main_text.p: Barttoon, Manipulus: nos gerben] Hoc Teuton. gaertoe, garbe, Gallis gerbe, Latino-barbaris garba: nec longè abit Sax. ʒnipe, unde noftrum grtpe, eâdem notione.
Bedzuft, Turbata] Hoc Saxon. ʒe-opeẹeo, & ʒeopeḥtz.
Beberge, Cubilibus: ab occultando] Vide Cl. Spelman. in voce Ber-glum.
Begrabanuft, Sculptilia] Sculptile, Sax. ʒnapen, nobis hodie graben, quemadmodum statua nobis vulgò a graben image.
Un-gefremit, Imperfectum] Hoc Sax.onʒepnemeo, & unʒepnemeo ; voce composita à negandi five privandi particula, on,un, i.e. non,& ʒepne-meo, perfectus.

Behnozdn, Fornicati: alludit ad hoere, meretricem] Meretrix Saxon. hope,nobis (to, voci perperam præpo-nentibus)toboze : perperam dico; nam ab hypan venit, i.e.precio conducere, quod vox etiam Latina sat plane confirmat.
Belabt, Confensu: an gelibt?] Sax. confensus;

page.notes: Marginal and Old Saxon words are set in black letter and Greek in several places; several readings are doubtful, especially the Saxon glosses and the left-margin catchwords, and are transcribed approximately. Small marks in the right margin are reference marks or show-through and are omitted.
